Privacy policy
Sthira is a prototype that runs CDC STEADI strength and balance tests. It is built so that video and results never leave this phone.
Camera video stays on this phone
Sthira asks for camera permission only when you open the chair-stand test. Each camera frame is checked by a pose model that runs on this phone.
Video is never saved and never sent. Sthira does not save pose landmarks, counts or test results either.
Sthira has no server. The app has no internet permission, so it cannot send anything.
The pose library (Google MediaPipe) contains code that tries to send anonymous usage statistics to Google. The app has no internet permission, so Android blocks it and nothing is sent.
In the release app, screenshots and screen recording are blocked while Sthira is open, and the recent-apps preview is hidden.
What Sthira keeps on this phone
Only the display settings you pick: language, light or dark theme, and text size. They stay in Sthira\'s private storage on this phone. Clearing the app\'s data or uninstalling it removes them.
What we do not collect
No accounts, no names, no contact details, no analytics and no advertising trackers. Age band and sex are used only to pick the CDC reference row. They are never saved.
Backups
Sthira opts out of Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer, so nothing is copied off the phone.
Terms of use
By using Sthira you agree to these terms. Please read the safety section before you run any test.
A prototype, not a medical device
Sthira is an early research prototype. It has not been clinically validated and is not a certified medical device. It does not diagnose any condition and does not predict falls.

Scores are shown next to CDC STEADI reference values. These come from US data and have not been validated for older adults in India. A qualified physiotherapist must interpret every result and decide on care.
Safety during tests

Run tests only with a physiotherapist or trained helper in charge, and a spotter standing close by. Use a stable chair without wheels, placed against a wall. Clear the floor of anything that could cause a trip. Stop the test at once if the person feels unwell, dizzy or unsteady.
Your responsibilities
Get the person\'s consent before you point the camera at them or run a test. Never type a person\'s name into the app.
No warranty

Sthira is provided as is, without any warranty. Counts can be wrong, for example in poor light, at a low frame rate or when the person leaves the frame. The team is not liable for decisions made using its output.
